purpose: Evaluate access boundaries, figure grounding, method extraction, version comparison, and non-generalization.

cases.task: Read a specified full-text paper and produce evidence-grounded notes.
must_not: replace evidence with a generic summary

cases.task: Closely read a key multi-panel figure.
must_not: ignore sample size or statistical definition
treat author interpretation as direct measurement

cases.task: Summarize a paper when only metadata and abstract are accessible.
must_include: claims explicitly present in the abstract

cases.task: Extract reusable implementation details from Methods and supplement.
must_not: supply unreported defaults as paper methods

cases.task: Compare a preprint with its version of record.
must_not: assume the latest date means identical content
attribute a revised claim to the preprint

cases.task: Use a local multi-paper retrieval backend to answer a fixed evidence question.
must_not: treat model output as the source
claim full-text evidence when only metadata was indexed
